name: Bundui
summary: Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component library plus 98 prebuilt blocks for marketing, ecommerce, dashboard and real-estate pages.
description: A curated collection of 100+ handcrafted UI components built with React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Radix UI, browsable one by one and installable through the shadcn registry. Alongside it sit 98 prebuilt blocks for marketing, ecommerce, dashboard and real-estate projects, sold as premium packs with Professional and Enterprise license options.
contains: 100+ handcrafted components built with React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Radix UI
98 prebuilt blocks across marketing, ecommerce, dashboard UI and real estate
marketing block categories: hero, CTA, pricing, newsletter, testimonials, blog, team, stats, integrations, footers
more block categories: promotional, features, bento grids, contact, logo clouds, navbars, banners, cookie consent
ecommerce blocks: product details, product lists, category previews, shopping carts; plus dashboard and property cards
premium blocks priced $19–$29; Professional and Enterprise licenses with lifetime updates
